mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, type, post_id, comment_id, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{actorId}, #{type}, #{postId}, #{commentId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = 0

SELECT n.notification_id, n.type, n.actor_id, CASE WHEN u.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE u.nickname END AS actor_nickname, n.post_id, p.title AS post_title, n.comment_id, n.is_read AS `read`, n.created_at FROM notifications n JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.actor_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = n.post_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.notification_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = 0
